newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends up on central bank action.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends up on central bank action.

text.p: The South Korean won ended Thursday's trading higher against the dollar, buoyed by supportive dollar sales by the central Bank of Korea, dealers said.
Dealers said the central bank sold dollars during late morning trading at 884.80 won.
The bank has refused to comment on talk of its intervention in interbank trading.
The won ended at 884.00, compared to Wednesday's close of 884.80. It opened Thursday's trading at 884.70, and moved between 881.50 and 884.90.
